purpose: Searches for occurrences of query text or regex pattern within text body or list of strings.
capability: Finds line numbers and snippets of matching pattern across multi-line text.

output.matches: list of dicts with line_number, line_text, start, end

interface: index.py -> search_text_pattern(text: str, query: str, is_regex: bool = False, case_sensitive: bool = True) -> dict
failure_behavior: Returns empty matches list when query is empty or not found.
